record.what_it_does: Pay-as-you-go APIs for SEO data: SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, and business data.
record.auth_notes: HTTP Basic with an API login and an auto-generated API password. Each account has one credential pair. There is no OAuth, so a multi-user toolkit would have each user paste in their own login and password.
record.access_notes: A free account gives API credentials, and the free Sandbox returns sample responses. New accounts get a $1 trial credit. Live data needs a prepaid balance with a $50 minimum top-up. There is no subscription, and funds don't expire.
record.api_breadth_notes: Covers SERP, Keywords Data, Labs, Backlinks, On-Page, Domain Analytics, Content Analysis, Business Data, App Data, Merchant and AI Optimization. Each has many endpoints, and the total is well over 50.
record.mcp_notes: Remote endpoint https://mcp.dataforseo.com/mcp. The npm package dataforseo-mcp-server and the Docker image dataforseo/mcp are also official. Repo: dataforseo/mcp-server-typescript.
record.blocker_notes: Users need their own DataForSEO account, and live data needs a funded balance. Basic auth means per-user credential entry instead of an OAuth flow.

evidence.quote: Authenticate using HTTP Basic Authentication ... API login and password on the API Access tab

record.needs_human: Not checked: whether an OpenAPI spec is published. The webhooks answer comes from memory of the postback_url and pingback_url task options, not from a fetched page. The quotes for auth and access come from fetched-page summaries, so they are paraphrased and not verbatim. The MCP evidence quote is only a search-result title.
